Variable Scope and Lifetime

Stage 3 Concept ⏱ 12 min 📖 Glossary

Scope = where a variable is visible and alive. Braces are hotel rooms — what happens inside usually stays inside.

🔎 Motivating questionWhy can’t the lobby hear your shower singing?

Objectives

  • Explain block scope
  • Spot shadowing
  • Fix scope errors

Needs first: Parameters and Return Values

1 Start with an analogy

Real life first, code second.

Hotel rooms: lobby variable visible everywhere on floor; room variable dies at checkout (}). Inner rooms see outer; outer cannot see inner.

⚠️ Where the analogy breaksWhere it breaks: hotels share Wi-Fi. Code rooms share nothing unless passed as parameters — no snooping.

2 The concept, plainly

One idea at a time, words before jargon.

Block scope: declared in { } lives there only. Loop counter dies after loop.

Shadowing: inner same-name hides outer — confusing, avoid.

Lifetime: created at declaration, destroyed at }. Use smallest scope.

3 Watch it move: Hotel rooms

Step at your pace. Text explains every move.

4 Live code demo

Small, correct Java 17 (LTS) code. Read, trace, copy.

Main.javaJava 17
int hall = 1;
if (true) {
  int room = 2;
  System.out.println(hall + room); // 3
}
System.out.println(hall); // 1
// System.out.println(room); // ERROR: gone
▶ Output 3 1
  • hall visible inside.
  • room dies at }.
  • Uncommented line fails.
💡 Why this output?Inner sees outer; outer cannot see inner after checkout.

5 Interactive experiment

Change values, watch consequences. Simulation — honest, not a real compiler.

Try it (visual simulation — not a real compiler)
Rooms: combine hall + room.

6 Common mistakes (at least 3)

Wrong, why, fixed — learn from realistic slips.

❌ Mistake 1: Using loop i after loopWhy: Checked out.
✅ Fix: Declare before loop if needed.
❌ Mistake 2: Shadowing: two agesWhy: Which age?!
✅ Fix: Rename inner.
❌ Mistake 3: Giant method-wide varsWhy: Everything sees, bugs hide.
✅ Fix: Declare close to use.

7 Guided practice

Hints first, solutions only after a real try.

Alive?

{ int q=5; } print(q) — works?

HintChecked out.
SolutionNo — out of scope.
Fix shadow

Fix: int x=1; { int x=2; }

HintRename.
Solutionint y = 2; inside.

8 Lesson quiz

3+ questions. Attempts saved locally; review queue learns your weak spots.

9 Takeaways + next step

  • Braces bound life.
  • Inner sees outer, not reverse.
  • Smallest scope wins.
